scene:visible_bingo_card.object_description: one face-up 5 x 5 bingo card with some cells marked

query:completed_column_label.completed_column_rule_text: Exactly one BINGO column has all five cells marked.
query:completed_column_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the completed column label as B, I, N, G, or O
query:completed_column_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one pair of pixel-space points [x, y]: the centers of the top and bottom cells in the completed column

query:line_sum_extremum_value.line_sum_extremum_rule_text: A completed line has all five cells marked. Sum the printed numbers in each completed requested line, then use the requested extreme sum.
query:line_sum_extremum_value.answer_hint: set "answer" to the unique requested extreme sum among completed requested lines
query:line_sum_extremum_value.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the five cells in the completed requested line with the unique requested extreme sum

query:near_complete_row_count.near_complete_line_rule_text: A near-complete row is a row with exactly one unmarked cell.
query:near_complete_row_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of near-complete rows
query:near_complete_row_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the single unmarked gap cell in each near-complete row

query:near_complete_column_count.near_complete_line_rule_text: A near-complete column is a column with exactly one unmarked cell.
query:near_complete_column_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of near-complete columns
query:near_complete_column_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the single unmarked gap cell in each near-complete column

query:called_marked_number_count.called_marked_number_rule_text: The CALLED list shows numbers that appear on the card.
query:called_marked_number_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of called numbers that are marked on the card
query:called_marked_number_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for each card cell whose number is in the CALLED list and is marked
